blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Most offices use a small set of digital tools every day. Teams or Slack for chat and calls. Zoom or Google Meet for video meetings. SharePoint or Google Drive for files. Outlook or Gmail for email. A tool like Trello, Asana, or Jira for tracking work.

The tools are not the hard part. Most people can learn them in a few days. The hard part is using them well. A good Teams message is short and clear, with a good subject line. A good meeting has an agenda and ends with action items. A good shared drive has a clean folder structure that everyone follows.

Tools only save time when everyone uses them the same way.

items.q: According to the text, what is the hard part?
items.why: "The tools are not the hard part… The hard part is using them well."

items.q: What does a good meeting have?
items.why: "A good meeting has an agenda and ends with action items."

items.q: When do tools save time?
options: When everyone uses them the same way
When there are many of them
When only the manager uses them
items.why: "Tools only save time when everyone uses them the same way."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: A message should be short and clear
Buying new tools solves every problem
Everyone should follow the same folder structure
Meetings should end with action items
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que a ferramenta é fácil; o difícil é o uso. Comprar mais ferramentas não é a solução.

items.q: The text suggests that a good subject line helps because…
items.why: Inferência: uma boa linha de assunto faz parte de uma mensagem curta e clara.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily falando com um novo colaborador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! I want to show you something about our meetings, because it will help you a lot in your first week.

People here say our meetings are slow. They think the tools are the problem. But the tools are fine. We use Teams for chat and Zoom for video, and they work well. The problem is not the tools. The problem is how we use them.

Look at this meeting from Monday. There is no agenda. Nobody knows the plan. So people talk for one hour and nothing happens. There are no action items. And next week, we have the same slow meeting all over again.

My advice is simple. Before every meeting, write a short agenda. Just three or four points is enough. At the end, write the action items. Who does what, and when. Then send it in the chat with a clear subject line, so everyone can find it.

The tool is not slow. The people are slow when they have no plan. A good agenda saves everyone time. Try it in your first meeting this week, and you will see the difference.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What do people say about the meetings?
items.why: "People here say our meetings are slow."

items.q: According to Emily, what is the real problem?
options: How the people use the tools
items.why: "The tools are fine… The problem is how we use them."

items.q: What is Emily's advice before a meeting?
items.why: "Before every meeting, write a short agenda."

items.q: Emily suggests that a meeting with no agenda…
options: wastes an hour with no results
items.why: Inferência: sem pauta, as pessoas falam uma hora e nada acontece.

items.q: How would you describe Emily's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela dá boas-vindas e explica um conselho simples e prático.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please write a clear subject line in your email." A subject line is…
options: the short title of the email
items.why: Subject line = linha de assunto: o título curto no topo do e-mail.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Every meeting needs an ___ so people know the plan."
items.why: Agenda = pauta: a lista de pontos da reunião.

items.q: "At the end, we wrote the action items." Action items are…
items.why: Action item = item de ação: a tarefa e quem a faz.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Save the report in the ___ so everyone can open it."
items.why: Shared drive = drive compartilhado: onde o time guarda os arquivos.

items.q: "A clean folder structure helps you find files fast." A folder structure is…
items.why: Folder structure = estrutura de pastas: como as pastas estão organizadas.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no trabalho com ferramentas digitais. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you set up the Zoom call for 3 p.m.?" To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar, organizar (a chamada, a reunião).

items.q: "Let's roll out the new tool to all teams next month." To roll out means to…
options: start using it step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar aos poucos, colocar em uso.

items.q: "Please follow up on the action items from Monday." To follow up means to…
options: check the progress and remind people
items.why: Follow up = dar seguimento, cobrar o andamento.

items.q: "I will log in to Teams before the meeting." To log in means to…
options: enter the app with your account
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com seu usuário e senha.

items.q: "Can you send over the file on the shared drive?" To send over means to…
options: share or forward it to someone
items.why: Send over = enviar, mandar algo para alguém.
